{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p2","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m2","note":"The Inca stonework here still holds its curves under Inti (the sun), a quiet marvel of old Cusco."},{"poi_id":"p5","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Gold leaf, cedar and a painting of a very Andean Last Supper make this cathedral feel wonderfully local."},{"poi_id":"p16","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"A refined take on Andean flavours, with thoughtful vegetarian plates that still taste like Cusco."},{"poi_id":"p4","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m4","note":"Follow the juice ladies and herb stalls to the market's lively heart, where daily Cusco does its shopping."},{"poi_id":"p6","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Wander the steep lanes of San Blas, where tiny workshops and blue doors hide some of the city's best crafts."},{"poi_id":"p18","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"A cosy, wood-fired corner for honest pizza and pasta, with plenty of meat-free comfort on the menu."}]}
A gentle landing in the Imperial City, a morning up among the Pisac ruins, then faith, markets and Inca echoes before we wave goodbye.
